subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should this public transcript terminal-control report proceed as a normal public CLI hardening bugfix, or pause for security-triage/advisory handling first?
rationale: The root cause and fix boundary are narrow, but untrusted imported text can emit terminal control sequences through an operator-facing CLI path and the issue already carries security-review labels.

options.title: Proceed With Public Hardening Fix

options.title: Route Through Security Triage
